chunk_summary: Full distillation starts with a complete source inventory, normalized text hashes, stable line chunks, and a queue that cannot remain pending.

l0.one_liner: Inventory and hash every source, create stable line chunks, and block completion while any chunk is pending.

l1.brief: A complete source manifest and gap-free chunk ledger establish the boundary that semantic distillation must cover.
safety_red_lines: Do not claim full_text_status complete for unsupported, unreadable, or skipped visible source files.
uncertainties: A hash establishes byte identity, not truth, ownership, or semantic quality.

workflow: Enumerate every supported source file and reject unsupported visible files.
Copy normalized full text, hash original and normalized bytes, and create stable line-bounded chunks.
Create one pending work item per chunk and require a validated semantic artifact before completion.
load_more_if: The source changed after intake or chunk coverage has a gap.

provenance.claim: Inventory, hashes, stable chunks, and pending-queue completeness form the coverage gate.

anti_trigger_notes.reason: A summary-only request does not require the full skill lifecycle.

uncertainties: The source's own redistribution terms still require human review outside this synthetic fixture.
